mapper.select:
select 'PT' as label, ifnull(sum(actualamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_service where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(servicetype) = 'PT' and createdat between now() - 30 and now()
union all
select 'VOUCHER' as label, ifnull(sum(actualamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_service where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(servicetype) = 'VOUCHER' and createdat between now() - 30 and now()
union all
select 'CLOTHES' as label, ifnull(sum(totalamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_item where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(producttype) = 'CLOTHES' and createdat between now() - 30 and now()
union all
select 'DRINK' as label, ifnull(sum(totalamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_item where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(producttype) = 'DRINK' and createdat between now() - 30 and now()
union all
select 'SUPPLEMENTS' as label, ifnull(sum(totalamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_item where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(producttype) = 'SUPPLEMENTS' and createdat between now() - 30 and now()

select upper(service_type) as label, ifnull(sum(actualamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_service where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(service_type) in ('PT', 'VOUCHER') group by upper(service_type) order by label

select upper(product_type) as label, ifnull(sum(totalamount), 0) as total_sales from sales_item where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' and upper(product_type) in ('CLOTHES', 'DRINK', 'SUPPLEMENTS') group by upper(product_type) order by label

select e.empname as label, ifnull(sum(p.countchange), 0) as total_sessions from pt_log p join employee e on p.empnum = e.empnum where date_format(p.createdat, '%Y-%m') = date_format(date_sub(now(), interval 1 month), '%Y-%m') and p.status in ('소비', '예약취소') group by e.empname order by total_sessions desc limit 5

select date_format(memcreated, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as predictedcount, '실제' as data_type from member where memcreated < date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01') group by date_format(memcreated, '%Y-%m')
union all
select date_format(predict_date, '%Y-%m') as month, predicted_count as predictedcount, '예측' as data_type from ai_member_prediction
order by month asc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_member_prediction ( predict_date, predicted_count, created_at ) values ( str_to_date(#{predictDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{predictedCount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, now() )
mapper.select: select extract(year from s.sales_date) as year, extract(month from s.sales_date) as month, sum(s.totalamount) as totalamount, sum(s.actualamount) as actualamount from ( select createdat, totalamount, actualamount from sales_service union all select createdat, totalamount, totalamount as actualamount from sales_item ) s where extract(year from s.createdat) between extract(year from now()) - 2 and extract(year from now()) group by extract(year from s.createdat), extract(month from s.createdat) order by year, month

select year, month, sum(totalamount) as totalamount, sum(predicted_sales) as predicted_sales from ( select extract(year from s.createdat) as year, extract(month from s.createdat) as month, sum(s.amount) as totalamount, 0 as predicted_sales FROM ( select createdat, actualamount as amount from sales_service where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE'
union all
select createdat, totalamount as amount from sales_item where upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' ) s where extract(year from s.createdat) between extract(year from now()) - 1 and extract(year from now()) group by extract(year from s.createdat), extract(month from s.createdat)
union all
select p.predict_year as year, p.predict_month as month, 0 as totalamount, p.predicted_sales as predicted_sales from ai_sales_prediction p where p.predict_year = extract(year from now()) + 1 ) as t group by year, month order by year, month
select count(distinct case when v.enddate >= now() then v.memnum end) as valid, count(distinct case when v.enddate < now() then v.memnum end) as expired from voucher_log v where v.memnum is not null

select count(case when total_remain > 0 then 1 end) as remaining_count, count(case when total_remain <= 0 then 1 end) as exhausted_count from ( select memnum, sum(countchange) as total_remain from pt_log group by memnum ) as t
